title: Maximum Product Subarray
description: Given an integer array `nums`, find a non-empty contiguous subarray whose product is as large as possible and return that product.

examples.explanation: Any subarray containing both negatives also contains 0.

constraints: The answer fits in a 32-bit integer
hints: Max-subarray's trick of tracking only the best sum fails here because a negative can turn a very small product into a very large one.
For each position keep both the largest and the smallest product of a subarray ending there.
The new max/min is chosen from: the element alone, element times old max, element times old min. Update the global best from the max.

solution.explanation: Track the maximum and minimum product of subarrays ending at the current index, because multiplying by a negative swaps their roles. At each element, the new max and min are the best and worst of the element itself, element times old max, and element times old min. The answer is the largest max seen. One pass: O(n) time, O(1) space.
